name: Workday

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org - Wikipedia infobox logo file: Workday logo.svg

description: Workday sells cloud software that large organisations use to run human resources, payroll, finance and planning, plus a growing set of AI agents and tools (Sana, Paradox, HiredScore, Flowise, Pipedream). It serves more than 11,500 organisations with over 75 million users under contract, including more than 65 percent of the Fortune 500. About 92 percent of revenue is subscriptions on multi-year contracts (total subscription revenue backlog of $28.1B at 2026-01-31); the rest is professional services for implementations. It is moving into mid-sized enterprises and the US federal government.

employees.note: "over 21,000" in 36 countries; about 58% US and 42% international (FY2026 10-K)

businessLines.name: Subscription services
businessLines.how: Customers sign multi-year subscriptions priced on employee counts and modules, invoiced annually in advance and recognised evenly over the term; growth comes from new customers, more modules and renewals.
businessLines.description: Cloud applications for HR, payroll, finance, planning, recruiting and AI agents.

businessLines.name: Professional services
businessLines.how: Time-and-materials or fixed-fee project fees to implement the software; largely delivered with partners.

brands.name: Adaptive Planning, Peakon, VNDLY, Evisort, Flowise, Pipedream
